title: Per-state transition re-estimation for the chain-HMM aligner
hypothesis: Fixed 0.5 stay probabilities force every phoneme class to an expected 60 ms (3 states x 2 frames each), which EXP-0021 measured as a vowel/stop duration ratio of 1.43. Re-estimating one stay probability per state from expected transition counts should let decoded phone durations follow the corpus instead of the prior, without changing anything else.
